theorems.name: Submission.lpf_c1_approximation_eucl
theorems.statement: ∀ (n Q : ℕ) (u : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K u → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ (A : Set (Eucl n)) (G : Eucl n → Eucl Q), IsClosed A ∧ (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) Aᶜ < ε ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 G ∧ ∀ x ∈ A, u x = G x ∧ HasFDerivAt u (fderiv ℝ G x) x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
